Dear Ms Keller,

I am writing to apply for the position of Logistics Coordinator at Brüggli AG. I have 4 years' experience in warehouse planning, and I am confident that my skills are a good match. In my current role at Mueller Transport I reduced delivery errors by 18% and I was responsible for a team of five. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application.

Yours sincerely,
Marc Baumann
